extDescription.message: Asks what you're planning to do when you open the LinkedIn feed, and reminds you after a few minutes.

promptTitle.message: How much time do you want to sacrifice to the LinkedIn feed right now?

promptSubtitle.message: You installed this extension to stay focused and avoid getting sucked into the feed.

suggestionWalk.message: Close LinkedIn and go for a walk

suggestionCoffee.message: Close LinkedIn and grab a coffee

suggestionWater.message: Close LinkedIn and drink a glass of water

suggestionStretch.message: Close LinkedIn and stretch for a minute

suggestionBreathe.message: Close LinkedIn and take a few deep breaths

permissionReminderTitle.message: LinkedIn Feed Reminder needs your OK

permissionReminderMessage.message: Right-click the Extensions (puzzle-piece) icon → this extension → set "Access your data for all websites" to "Always Allow". Otherwise access only lasts for this visit.
